item.title: SALT Gym June Holiday Opening Schedule (2–12 June 2026)
item.description: Good day students, The SALT Gym will be open during the June Holidays with the following operating schedule: 📅 Operating Days: Monday to Friday 📆 Dates: 2 June – 12 June 2026 ⏰ Operating Hours: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM ✅ Entry Requirements: - Scan the Gym Entry QR Code upon entry - Full and clean PE attire only (no half-uniforms) - Covered sports shoes are required - Towel is compulsory (No towel, no entry) - Mobile phones are not allowed, except for scanning the Gym Entry QR Code 🏋️ Gym Usage Guidelines: 1) Maximum usage time: 60 minutes per student per session 2) Maximum capacity: 15 students at any one time 3) Students may be required to wait if the gym has reached full capacity 🏋️‍♂️ Equipment Available 1) Weight stack machines 2) Smith machine 3) Dumbbells (up to 20kg only) ⚠️ Important Notes - Students who do not comply with the gym rules may be asked to leave - In the event of lightning risk, gym capacity may be adjusted to support ongoing CCA activities We seek everyone’s cooperation in maintaining a safe and conducive gym environment for all users. Regards, SALT Department

item.title: [ECG] SGLaw200 Student Competition – Why Law Matters.
item.description: Dear Students, The Ministry of Law (MinLaw) invites you to participate in the SGLaw200 Student Competition – Why Law Matters. About SGLaw200 2. This year marks SGLaw200 – 200 years since Singapore’s modern judicial and legal system was established via the Second Charter of Justice in 1826. Our legal system is the foundation of the Rule of Law, which is a fundamental principle underpinning Singapore’s development. It has driven our economic growth, maintained racial and religious harmony, and supported our key social policies. SGLaw200 reiterates our commitment to the Rule of Law, and commemorates the past, present and future of Singapore’s legal system. For schools’ consideration - SGLaw200 Student Competition 3. Pre-University students are invited to share their appreciation and understanding of the Rule of Law and its impact on daily life by forming groups of 3-4 students to create a video or animation demonstrating how Singapore’s approach to Rule of Law and legal system can guide us forward as a united nation. The competition is open to all Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents. Students do not need to have prior legal knowledge to participate. 4. All entries are to be submitted by 30 June 2026. Winning entries will receive prizes worth up to $250. Please refer to the attached e-poster (Folio 1) and FAQs (Folio 2) for more information. Thank you Ms Khadija A ECG Unit

item.title: [ECG] Invitation ) Advisory's Upcoming Events – May-June Ext
item.description: DearStudents, You are invited to join us at Advisory's upcoming event, Experience: Public Relations and Communications Association Asia Pacific (PRCA APAC). Experience: Public Relations and Communications Association Asia Pacific (PRCA APAC) Date: 3 June 2026, Tuesday | Time: 3:30pm to 7:00pm Venue: Temus HQ, 80 Pasir Panjang Rd, #22-81, S117372 Registration Deadline: 26 May 2026, Tuesday | Time: 11:59pm (GMT+8) Link to register: https://bit.ly/ExperiencePRCA PUBLIC RELATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS ASSOCIATION ASIA PACIFIC (PRCA APAC) | The PRCA APAC has built a reputation for itself as a respectable authority in advancing professional standards across the communications industry. With the body's dedication to ethical practice and industry accreditation, it has managed to play a salient role in elevating the credibility and integrity of public relations. As a trailblazer in the industry, PRCA serves as a vital platform for agencies, in-house practitioners, and emerging professionals to engage in meaningful dialogue. PRCA's work consistently demonstrates a forward-looking approach, addressing pertinent issues such as technological disruption, media trust, and strategic communications which matter more with the prevalence of social media in today's context. Further, most youth currently purely scrape the surface of what public relations is about – this opportunity would enable them to develop a deeper understanding of how public relations blends storytelling, psychology and strategy. Those interested in writing, current affairs, content creation and more can also stand to discover the dynamism which this industry offers. Through Experience: PRCA APAC, Advisory hopes to give students a closer look at the Public Relations industry and career opportunities at PRCA APAC — through immersive sessions with professionals who aim to create a more ethical and prosperous PR industry. Register at https://bit.ly/ExperiencePRCA by 26 May 2026, 11:59pm. Thank you Ms Khadija A ECG Unit
